notes.title: Ver 1.1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Ver 1.1.5 Update Notes:

Updated the graphics renderer for modern machines
Changed the save file format

notes.title: Ver 1.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Ver 1.1.3 Update Notes:

 Fixed a bug that may crash the game towards the later part of the story
 Added a warning on the title screen for selections such as New Game that an existing autosave will be overwritten if proceeding, reminding players there really is only ONE autosave allowed at any time
